newsitem.title: CHINA: China wastage of production capacity high.
newsitem.headline: China wastage of production capacity high.

text.p: More than half of China's production capacity of many key products, including automobiles, colour TVs and air conditioners, is idle because of sluggish demand and strong imports, the Business News reported on Friday.

The newspaper published official statistics listing 18 products for which more than half the domestic production capacity is unused, also including computers, photographic film, paint and washing machines.
It said many factories had been forced to stop production as a result of the over-supply, but gave no details.
